description: Trading-engine patch guardrails; review and trust through Codex /hooks.

hooks.command:
python3 -c "import runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; exec('try:
 cwd=Path.cwd()
 root=next(p for p in (cwd,*cwd.parents) if (p/'.git').exists())
 sys.argv=[str(root/'scripts/codex_guardrails.py'),'hook']
 runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
except Exception:
 print('BLOCKED: hook initialization or validation failed.',file=sys.stderr)
 sys.exit(2)')"
